author: Forbes
description:
When traditional marketing metrics stopped keeping pace with modern car shoppers, Nissan CMO Allyson Witherspoon knew the brand needed a massive pivot. In this episode, Witherspoon explains how Nissan implemented a comprehensive AI-driven operating system to better understand consumers and connect with them exactly where they are searching. By shifting from traditional manufacturer-led marketing to algorithm-optimized discovery, Nissan achieved incredible results: shortening the purchase cycle, boosting conversion metrics, and driving retail sales growth to become the fastest-growing mainstream auto brand in the US.
